description.value: Canton Garden is a family-owned Cantonese restaurant with more than 60 years of history in Chilliwack, originally operating out of the Royal Hotel before moving to its current location near Highway 1. The dining room seats up to 200 people and includes private banquet facilities at no extra room charge, making it an easy stop for large cycling groups. Takeout is readily available by phone, and the extensive menu spans classic Cantonese dishes alongside a full vegetarian section.
